transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I'm here because the doctor at the clinic got on my case about my eating. But honestly, most days I just keep it pretty simple. I'll have coffee in the morning, maybe grab a few bites of something between painting jobs, and then just a small dinner if I'm not too wrapped up in paperwork for my classes. It doesn't seem like a big deal to me.
How do you feel about your current body weight or the idea of gaining weight?

I feel like my weight is fine where it is right now. It works for me. Gaining weight, though... that definitely stresses me out. 

If I eat something heavy, like a big sandwich or pizza or something, I actually get this panicky feeling. It's like I'm worried I'll just wake up the next day bigger and slower. And I really can't have that. I'm up and down ladders all day for my painting jobs, constantly moving around tight rooms, and I need to be light on my feet. I just worry I wouldn't be able to move around the way I need to if I put on weight.
Could you share your current height and weight with me?

I'm about 5'4", and last time I checked, I weighed around 98 pounds. I know my work pants are hanging pretty loose on me lately, and some of the guys on the job sites keep telling me I look too thin. But honestly, I just see it as leaning out. I'm on my feet all day, climbing ladders, so it makes sense that I'd be leaner.
Have you noticed any changes in your menstrual cycle, such as missed or stopped periods?
No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. Um, my periods are still coming every month pretty much like normal. So, no, no missed periods or anything.
